steps.narr: Your eSIM is dead. Xiao Lin's outside; you can't call her. 📵
steps.zh: 手机卡没信号，小林在外面等，你却打不了电话。

steps.en: What's wrong? Is your phone broken?

say.en: Tell him your phone has no signal.
say.tip: 信号 xìnhào = signal. 没信号了: the 了 says it has just stopped working.

ok.zh: 哦，那你连一下机场的网嘛。
ok.en: Oh, then just connect to the airport Wi-Fi.

ok.narr: The airport Wi-Fi wants a code by text message. To your phone. Which has no signal.
ok.zh: 机场的网要短信验证码，可你的手机没信号。

say.en: Ask if you can borrow his phone to make a call.
say.gloss: Could I borrow your phone to make a call?
answers: 大叔，能借您的手机打个电话吗？
能借你的手机打个电话吗？
可以借一下您的手机吗？
我能用一下你的手机吗？
借我手机打个电话，可以吗？

not.note: 借给你 is 'lend to you': you want 借你的手机.

say.tip: 借 jiè = borrow. To an older stranger, 您 (the polite 你) is the warmer choice. 打个电话 = make a quick call.

mistakes.note: 借给你 means 'lend to you'. You want 借你的手机 (borrow your phone).

ok.zh: 借手机？你不会是骗子吧？
ok.en: Borrow my phone? You're not a scammer, are you?

miss.zh: 没事儿的话，我先走了啊。
miss.en: Well, if that's all, I'll be off.
Xiao Lin gives up and drives home. You spend the night on a bench at Exit 3. 🪑
miss.zh: 小林等不到你，开车回家了。你在三号出口睡了一夜。

0.tip: 借一下 = borrow for a moment.

say.en: Reassure him: you're not a scammer, it'll only take a minute.
say.gloss: Don't worry, I'm not a scammer. Just one minute!
answers: 放心，我不是骗子，就一分钟！
我不是骗子，就打一分钟。

not.note: That says you ARE one: 我不是骗子.

say.tip: 放心 fàngxīn = don't worry (literally 'put your heart down'). 就一分钟 = just one minute.

alts.en: Offer him your passport as a deposit
alts.gloss: I'll leave my passport with you as a deposit.

then.zh: 哈哈，护照就不用了！你这人真逗。给，打吧。
then.en: Ha! Keep your passport. You're a funny one. Here, go ahead.

ok.zh: 哈哈，开玩笑的。给，你打吧。
ok.en: Haha, just kidding. Here, go ahead.

fail.en: Hmm... I'm still not so sure about this.

miss.zh: 算了，你打吧，我在旁边盯着。
miss.en: Fine, make your call. I'll be watching you.

say.en: Tell her it's you, and you're at Exit 3.
answers: 喂，是我，我在三号门这儿。
say.tip: 是我 = it's me. 三号出口 = exit number three; 号 works like 'No.'

ok.zh: 你怎么用别人的手机？算了，我马上到，别乱跑！
ok.en: Why are you on someone else's phone? Never mind, I'll be right there. Don't wander off!

miss.zh: 不说话？又是骗子电话吧！
miss.en: Nothing? Another scam call, I bet!
Xiao Lin hangs up and blocks the number. The uncle's phone is now on her scam list.
miss.zh: 小林挂了电话，还把大叔的号码拉黑了。

say.en: Give the phone back and thank him: he saved you.
say.gloss: Thank you so much, you've saved me!
answers: 太谢谢您了，您真是救了我！
谢谢你，你帮了我大忙了！
say.tip: 帮了我大忙 = did me a big favour. 救了我 = saved me. 您 is the polite 你.

ok.zh: 客气啥！出门在外，谁还没个难处。
ok.en: Don't mention it! Away from home, everyone hits a rough patch.

miss.zh: 连声谢谢都没有？现在的年轻人啊……
miss.en: Not even a thank-you? Young people these days...

0.tip: 谢谢您: 您 is the polite 你.

steps.en: Xiao Lin pulls up, honking. Saved by a stranger with a thermos.
steps.zh: 小林按着喇叭开过来了。
